name: odoo-mcp
description: Read-only Odoo tasks for Codex, through the MCP Server for Odoo add-on from Mithahara.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Codex about your Odoo data, read-only
interface.longDescription: Three read-only skills that run through the MCP Server for Odoo add-on from Mithahara: overdue invoices, record history, and who can see a model. You point Codex at your own Odoo in config.toml; nothing is written.
defaultPrompt: Which customer invoices are overdue in Odoo?
